| `input-event-correlation` | [s1.28](../brainstorming.md#s1.28) | PY | live |  |  | capture mouse and keyboard events (DTrace) and correlate them with the screenshots; a polyglot workflow |
| `stream-dialing` | [s1.28](../brainstorming.md#s1.28) | PY | live | ＋ [s1.29](../brainstorming.md#s1.29) |  | the harness decides what is noise and turns input streams off or on |
| `institution-owns-the-harness` | [s1.28](../brainstorming.md#s1.28) | PY | live |  |  | the institution owns the learning instead of a vendor data-mining their CAD usage |
| `over-the-shoulder-suggestions` | [s1.28](../brainstorming.md#s1.28) | PY | live |  |  | a live suggestion tool learned from the user's intuitions |
| `supervisory-outer-loop` | [s1.29](../brainstorming.md#s1.29) | P | live |  |  | an outer loop learns from the harness's productivity, observability, and output streams and proactively increases the tooling's affordances |
| `bit-storage-reduction` | [s1.29](../brainstorming.md#s1.29) | P | live |  |  | reduce the overall bit storage load over time while getting value in different time domains |
| `ui-nontechnical-config` | [s1.29](../brainstorming.md#s1.29) | P | live |  |  | non-technical people configure the harness from what they already know and use |
| `media-flow-viz` | [s1.29](../brainstorming.md#s1.29) | P | live |  |  | visualize the media flows, how they come in and how they are shaped over time |
| `harness-evolution-viz` | [s1.29](../brainstorming.md#s1.29) | P | live |  |  | a very simple visualization of the harness planning, building, and evolving |
| `icp-directions-exploration` | [s1.30](../brainstorming.md#s1.30) | P | live |  |  | lay several directions side by side (focus, example use case, company type, lander messaging), estimate in parallel, then decide |

## Questions

The decision space. Open questions are the annealing worklist; resolved ones say where the answer landed.

| Seg | Question | Resolution |
|---|---|---|
| [s1.05](../brainstorming.md#s1.05) | What do we want our harness to do? | media-heavy workflows for a business (s1.06); the use case is dialed in at s1.26 and s1.30 |
| [s1.09](../brainstorming.md#s1.09) | Generic image harness, or one specific use case? | contemplate a plurality of use cases, then pick one slice for the hackathon (s1.22, s1.30) |
| [s1.10](../brainstorming.md#s1.10) | Which businesses generate and use lots of images? | advertising, marketing, trend analysis (s1.11); construction (s1.18); interior design (s1.26) |
| [s1.12](../brainstorming.md#s1.12) | Does the fix loop belong to Plan or to Instrument? | Plan selects the mode each iteration; the loop runs on the harness itself (s1.12) |
| [s1.19](../brainstorming.md#s1.19) | Is compliance-driven media reuse a wide enough value proposition? | reframed at s1.20: value comes from what we store, and the harness serves that |
| [s1.20](../brainstorming.md#s1.20) | Self-improving harness, or long-term domain harness? | self-improving, built around the value of the media we store (s1.20); reframed against the rules in docs/00-vision.md#hackathon-framing |
| [s1.30](../brainstorming.md#s1.30) | Which ICP direction do we build for today? | **open** |
